en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a small whitewashed marabout (saint's shrine) with crenellated parapet near Oujda, Morocco. In front of the building are several adults and many children in traditional robes; at the right a person rides a camel led by another person. Trees and low brush form the background. Printed captions in French identify the scene as the Marabout de Sidi Yahia near Oujda, and indicate the publisher.
